name: context-menu
title: Context menu
description: A menu of actions opened by right click or long press on an area.
a11y: Opens with right click, long press or the context-menu key (Shift+F10).
Arrow keys move, Enter or Space selects, Escape closes and returns focus.
Every action must also exist elsewhere in the UI for people who cannot open it.
